run_iqn_atari_training: run the IQN agent training loop on an Atari environment like Pong with configurable hyperparameters
build_iqn_atari_network: build an IQN Atari network using networks.iqn_atari_network with a given number of actions and tau latent dimension
create_iqn_agent: create an IQN training agent with a preprocessor, network, optimizer, replay buffer, and exploration schedule
create_iqn_eval_agent: create an IQN epsilon greedy evaluation agent with a network, exploration epsilon, and tau samples
run_atari_environment_loop: run an Atari environment loop using parts.run_loop with a train or eval agent and max frames per episode
